title: Accessible ramp
lede: Gradient, run, rise and landing of a ramp under the 2024 Revised IRR.
cite: BP 344 Revised IRR (2024), Appendix A, A.1.2 and Table A.1.1
facts: Gradient not steeper than 1:20; 1:15 only in special cases
At 1:15 the run stops at 10.50 m and the rise at 700 mm
Landing every 15 m at 1:20, every 10 m at 1:15
Intermediate landing at least 1800 mm long
Level area of 1800 mm at the head and the foot
Minimum clear width 1200 mm; 100 mm raised edge each side
Handrails both sides at 700 mm and 900 mm, with 300 mm level extensions
Tactile warning strip 600 mm deep, 300 mm from head and foot

title: Accessible parking slot
lede: Why the accessible slot is 1500 mm wider than an ordinary one.
cite: BP 344 Revised IRR (2024), Appendix A, A.6.7
facts: Slot 4000 mm wide by 5000 mm long
Walkway of 1200 mm minimum between the front ends of parked cars
Located nearest the accessible main entrance
Dropped sidewalk or curb ramp where the walkway is raised
Pavement marking plus pole-mounted signage between adjacent slots
One slot for 1 to 25 parking slots, two for 26 to 50 (Table A.6.1)

title: Accessible toilet cubicle
lede: Cubicle size, water closet position and the two grab bars.
cite: BP 344 Revised IRR (2024), Appendix A, C.6.3
facts: Cubicle at least 1800 mm by 1800 mm
Water closet centreline 450 mm from the finished side wall
Fixed L-type grab bar one side, flip-up grab bar the other
Both bars 300 mm above the top of the toilet seat
350 mm clear from the face of either bar to the WC centreline
150 mm maximum between grab bar and the edge of the seat
Turning space of 1800 mm by 1800 mm outside the cubicle
One accessible cubicle per gender for every 20 cubicles or fewer
